title: Sparkly backpack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

    <path d='M14 20 l2.5 5 5 2.5 -5 2.5 -2.5 5 -2.5 -5 -5 -2.5 5 -2.5 z'/>
    <path d='M84 16 l2 4 4 2 -4 2 -2 4 -2 -4 -4 -2 4 -2 z'/>
    <path d='M88 62 l2 4 4 2 -4 2 -2 4 -2 -4 -4 -2 4 -2 z'/>
    <path d='M12 70 l2 4 4 2 -4 2 -2 4 -2 -4 -4 -2 4 -2 z'/>
    <path d='M50 8 l1.5 3 3 1.5 -3 1.5 -1.5 3 -1.5 -3 -3 -1.5 3 -1.5 z'/>
    <path d='M50 90 l1.5 3 3 1.5 -3 1.5 -1.5 3 -1.5 -3 -3 -1.5 3 -1.5 z'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#FFF3B0'>
    <path d='M24 84 l1.5 3 3 1.5 -3 1.5 -1.5 3 -1.5 -3 -3 -1.5 3 -1.5 z'/>

  <rect x='28' y='30' width='44' height='56' rx='10' fill='#5B3A8E'/>
  <!-- lighter side panel shading -->
  <rect x='30' y='34' width='6' height='48' rx='3' fill='#7E5AAE'/>
  <!-- lid / top flap -->
  <path d='M28 44 Q28 30 38 30 L62 30 Q72 30 72 44 Z' fill='#8E6BC0'/>
  <rect x='28' y='42' width='44' height='6' rx='3' fill='#A88AD8'/>

  <rect x='46' y='46' width='8' height='6' rx='2' fill='#F2C14E'/>
  <!-- bottom base -->
  <rect x='28' y='80' width='44' height='6' rx='3' fill='#4A2E76'/>
  <!-- top handle -->
  <path d='M44 30 Q50 22 56 30' fill='none' stroke='#A88AD8' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
